description: REGRESSION for the 'access to a DSN, but only some of its tables' scenario: the user has full table_perms (read/write/update/delete, scope-21..30) on tblA{{TSID}} and the same DSN-level access applies to every table in dsn-ts{{TSID}}, but has never been granted anything on tblB{{TSID}} -- a second table in the SAME restricted DSN. Must still be denied for tblB, proving a grant on one table does not leak to another table in the same DSN.
